title: INTERPLANE Decision (Crossveil)
description: The runtime's explicit authority decision about one capability request. Only a runtime produces this. A receiver that sees a decision value it does not know MUST treat it as denied.

policy_engine.description: Name of the runtime component that decided (e.g. odysseus.tool_capabilities, aien.safety_engine).

decision_id.description: Runtime-local id of the decision record, if any.

reason.description: Human-readable, redacted. Must not leak policy internals or secrets.

constraints.description: Restrictions attached to an authorization (e.g. AIEN AllowRestricted). Informational to the model; binding on the runtime.

approval.description: Present only with requires_approval. The approval_id is minted by the runtime and only the runtime can honour it.
